create.name: Natalie Ramon
create.bio:
Natalie Ramon first encountered energy healing while studying abroad in Glasgow and working in England's Lake District. Back in Canada, she trained in Reiki, and that set her on the path to Chinese medicine. She completed a five-year Doctor of TCM programme in Chinese medicine and acupuncture, including a hospital internship at Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine in 2009. She has run her own acupuncture practice in Greater Sudbury for well over a decade. She is a Registered Acupuncturist and Registered TCM Practitioner in Ontario.

During the pandemic she came back to qigong, which had been part of her original training, and wanted to go deeper. She travelled to Vietnam for a three-week White Tiger medical qigong intensive and is certified in the Five Animal Summer Path. She now runs medical qigong workshops and classes for her local community alongside her clinical practice, which includes integrative sessions combining acupuncture with energy work. Outside work she cross-country skis, skates, hikes and canoes, and her teaching follows the seasons in the same way.
